WR18.title: Joint checked Research guard omits saved submission / full deployment binding / nonempty terminal receipt
WR18.primary_reproduction: Record actual synthetic submission input_hash=d*64. Supply same-identity completion input_hash=e*64. Bridge.consume_completion rejects this exact observed object. Publish canonical evidence and result through public Registry.complete, without modifying recorded submission, existing result bytes or journal. Registry.begin_attempt for the same parent fixed LEAN op returns should_execute=True and debits LEAN total 0→1.
same_root_supplementary_cases: Empty platform.raw_receipt={} is refused by Bridge but admitted by Registry dependency guard.
No engineering/submissions/<attempt>.json exists; Bridge refuses completion, Registry dependency guard admits LEAN.
WR18.expected: The authoritative shared new-charge path rejects internally contradictory or incomplete checked Research before any new LEAN debit.
WR18.actual: All three malformed completion scenarios admitted; valid checked Research also admitted.

evidence_lines.meaning: New helper validates identity and canonical evidence, but does not read saved submission, compare full deployment/input_hash, or require nonempty raw receipt.
Only shape validation and plan source/deployment hashes are enforced.
Shared LOCK; joint admission line584, engineering cap line591, new budget charge line592.
Existing trusted Bridge requires a recorded submission, exact whole deployment and nonempty actual raw terminal receipt.
Generic public complete writes canonical result/journal digest and does not itself enforce engineering business evidence.

WR18.why_p2: A caller using the documented public Registry bypass path can obtain a new LEAN execution entitlement and spend its slot from evidence the trusted completion boundary explicitly refuses. This violates the newly added verified same-parent dependency contract. Reproduction is synthetic and has not caused a platform execution; global/domain caps still apply.
WR18.trust_boundary: This is an internally checkable consistency omission, not a claim that local hashes authenticate a remote platform, or that trusted generic callers cannot fabricate self-consistent JSON.
WR18.fix_recommendation: Factor a pure evidence validator shared by Bridge and Registry. While already under Registry.LOCK, read and validate saved submission and its evidence using direct store reads, require exact same identity/external/deployment including input_hash, and require nonempty safe completion raw_receipt. Do not call public snapshot/read_result/payload from the held transaction.

Preserve mixed legacy/joint two-process last-slot atomicity.
